title: ClearPath ACH Payment Record and Professional Services Projects Deposits
content:
A client that pays its ClearPath Managed IT Services billing by ACH carries a lower deposit percentage on a Professional Services Projects time-and-materials statement of work.

For a client whose ClearPath billing shows 6 or more payments received by ACH in the six months before signature, 5.0 percentage points are taken off the deposit percentage, 2.5 points for one showing 3 or more but fewer than 6 such payments, and none otherwise.

A payment counts toward the six-month window when fewer than six whole months separate its posted date from the signature date, which is the day the deposit is invoiced, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| ClearPath payments received by ACH in the six months | Points taken off |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 5.0 |
| 3 to 5 | 2.5 |
| 0 to 2 | none |

Payments received by wire, check or card do not count toward these figures.

Hypothetical illustration: a client with five ACH payments in the window and a sixth posted exactly six whole months before the signature date has five payments that count and 2.5 points taken off.
